item.tib: gsang 'dus dre'u nag mo'i sgrub gzhung nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor
item.coloph: srid pa'i rgyal mo las mkhan srog gi spu gri'i sgrub pa ni/ dang po ston pa gsang ba 'dus pas phyag len mdzad do/ phyi rabs don du srog gzhung bcug de nas mi gshen rim par brgyud de bsgrabs/ rgyal po khri srung sde (srong lde'u) btsan gyi ring la/ g.yung drung bon dar nub byung nas/ bla chen dran pa nam mkha' (mkhas) rgya gsum dang bcas te gter kha gsum la sbas/ nam zhig dar ba'i smon lam btab/ rma dang dpon gsas gnyis kyis gdan drangs/ de nas mkhas btsun rim par brgyud/ de nas ston pa bya rgod spu de la/ mtshan ldan g.yung drung rgyal mtshan gyis zhus/ de nas mkhas btsun g.yung drung 'od zer la gnang / de nas da lta se btsun blo gros rgyal mtshan bdag gis zhus/ bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling grub pa'o/ 'di sgrab rjes 'bring gang zag rnams/ ye shes dbal mo mngon grub nas/ g.yung drung bon bstan dar ba dang / sgrub gshen tshe nor longs spyod 'phel/ pha rol log lta'i g.yul las rab rgyal nas/ dam nyams dgra khams cham la phab nas kyang / bstan pa'i bka' srung dus kun rgyal ba dgyes 'gyur cig/
